name: drupal/lite_youtube_embed
description: This module provides an alternative field formatter for rendering YouTube videos with Paul Irish's Lite YouTube Embed library instead of the default OEmbed iframe.

suggest.oomphinc/composer-installers-extender: Needed if you want to load the library as npm-asset and placed into the 'libraries' directory.
suggest.npm-asset/lite-youtube-embed: Paul Irish's Lite YouTube Embed library as NPM asset.
